settings.name: ProteinGym v1.3 DMS substitutions, zero-shot, Spearman, official average over 217 assays
settings.definition: All 217 ProteinGym DMS substitution assays at upstream commit 144fe22 (v1.3). The model scores each variant without any training on the assay labels. Spearman correlation between scores and DMS fitness per assay, rounded to three decimals, then averaged with the official ProteinGym aggregation (mean by UniProt ID and selection type, then equal weight per selection-type category).

protocols.why: Results are the Average_Spearman column of benchmarks/DMS_zero_shot/substitutions/Spearman/Summary_performance_DMS_substitutions_Spearman.csv at commit 144fe22; dataset is 'ProteinGym DMS substitution assays at commit 144fe22 (217 assays)'; protocol_version v1.3.
protocols.differences: This protocol also holds the summary file's subset columns (Depth_1 to Depth_5+, Function_*, MSA depth, Taxa_*) as results with no conditions field; only the Average_Spearman rows belong to this setting. The file carries 400 of the protocol's 1,746 results, so only 23 systems were checked. Per-model scoring choices and input modalities are not recorded.

protocols.why: metric_qualifier: 'Spearman correlation averaged over the 217 substitution assays of ProteinGym v1.3 with the benchmark's official aggregation, from masked-marginal zero-shot scores; per-assay values rounded to three decimals before aggregation'; dataset is the same 'ProteinGym DMS substitution assays at commit 144fe22 (217 assays)' record.
protocols.differences: Values are the HyPLM authors' own BF16 runs with their masked-marginal implementation (one window centred on the position for long targets), not ProteinGym's published scores. Some values are read from Figure 3a bar labels (ESM-2 150M, 3B, 15B; ESM C 300M) rather than tables. The report says eight values between 0.403 and 0.420 are a statistical tie.

notes: Sixteen protocols. Only two cross-source tests exist in this file: the v1.3 full-suite zero-shot Spearman average (ProteinGym summary vs HyPLM report) and the AMFR single assay (ProteinGym assay-level CSV vs Rewire local runs). Eight systems match between ProteinGym and HyPLM by model_id and size; five agree within 0.001 and three differ (ESM-1b, ESM-2 15B, ESM3 open). The Rewire ESM-2 8M local run on AMFR reproduces the official assay-level value exactly (-0.209), which is a useful check on the runner. Protocol rewire-proteingym-v1-3-dms-substitutions stores 18 summary columns (average plus depth, function, MSA depth and taxon subsets) as separate results with no conditions field; it should be split so its Function_* columns can join the HyPLM per-category protocols as their own settings, and the record holds 1,746 results while this file shows 400, so more overlaps may exist. Candidate existing task for the first setting is proteingym-task-zs-sub-spearman, but that task does not pin a release or assay count, so it was not linked. The two GPN papers both use ProteinGym v0.1 in genomic coordinates but on different subsets (one assay with a custom cutoff vs 31 human assays) and different metrics, so they were left apart. The AMFR official record asks not to be merged with local protocols; linking here is for comparison only.
